page.content:
Banished prince who hunts the Avatar, then joins him.

How Zuko connects

  • Faction: Fire Nation — Zuko is a prince of the Fire Nation.
  • Character: Iroh — Iroh guides Zuko away from Ozai's path.
  • Character: Ozai — Zuko breaks from Ozai to help the Avatar.
  • Faction: The Gaang — Zuko finally joins the Gaang as Aang's firebending teacher.

What is Zuko?

Zuko is Fire Lord Ozai's scarred heir, sent to capture Aang, traveling with Uncle Iroh until he chooses the Gaang and a different Fire Nation.

Key threads lead to Fire Nation, Iroh, Ozai and The Gaang.
